en: Black‑and‑white historical image showing a line of uniformed soldiers standing guard at a wooden checkpoint barrier in front of a large, ornate European building. The soldiers wear early‑20th‑century dress uniforms with tall caps, rifles, and sabers. A small striped sentry box stands at the left. The overall look suggests a formal military guard post in an urban setting. There is a faint vertical notation along the left edge that appears to be a handwritten or printed catalog number.
